title: Open Cloze: Why We Dream (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.10) jednym slowem, tak aby powstal spojny i poprawny logicznie oraz gramatycznie tekst.
tasks.text: Every night, as we sleep, our minds create strange and vivid stories that we call dreams. For thousands of years, people 1.1. _________ wondered what these night-time visions actually mean. Some ancient cultures believed that dreams were messages 1.2. _________ the gods. Today, scientists have a rather different 1.3. _________ of looking at them. According 1.4. _________ many researchers, dreaming helps the brain to sort 1.5. _________ the memories of the day. Most dreams take place during a stage of sleep 1.6. _________ which the eyes move quickly behind closed lids. Although we may dream several times a night, we usually remember very 1.7. _________ of what we have seen. The harder we try to recall a dream, the 1.8. _________ quickly it seems to fade. Some people are even able to control their dreams 1.9. _________ they sleep. Whatever their true purpose, dreams remain one 1.10. _________ the great mysteries of the human mind.
